lines.text: Heheh. The pretty butterfly taught me how to draw nicer pictures.
So I started drawing a new storybook based on the places that the butterfly told me!

options: Carly! Your drawings are looking really good!
And you improved a lot from just a few lessons...

lines.text: Carly loves the fowls of Wuling! Miss Watchguard taught Carly that they're called the ... Paper-Crested Bowlbeasts!
Sable-chested fowlbeasts, Carly.
Oops. It's just a tiny mistake ... so yes! I love the Basil-Chested Fowlbeasts! Cos they keep running all over the place, just like explorers!
So I'm thinking ... about a Fowlbeast Explorer like me! The Fowl also loves adventuring and thus, it went to the very, very tall tower!
I met this Tianshi Lady who gave me lots of yummy food. She told me about the tower ... and there's a ... hmm. Heheh. I forgot about this part...
Miss Watchguard also told me about the two stone guardians who can ward off evil.
The guardians must be the ones helping to defeat the Evil, and brought peace to all of Wuling City.
Just like what the Endmin did for Valley IV and Wuling!
So this is what the gate looks like. Miss Watchguard told me about this place.
The gate is so big, Endmin. The fairytales taught me about giants. Maybe they live behind the gate.
I took a closer look and found the place really scary. Maybe there are monsters inside. Or even statues that can come to life and eat little children...
Oh? I remember! I think the pretty butterfly also told me about this place.

options: Tell me about: "It's A Stone King"

lines.text: I remember Miss Watchguard telling me about the tree. People say it's super scary, but I don't know if trees can actually scare people.
I didn't expect this. The leafless tree looks super scary... That's why I think there might be monsters in that place.
If the monsters are real, will they hurt us like the bad people?
Endmin, I just remembered something. The pretty butterfly told me about this place.
It said: "Uh-oh. This place is a little too dangerous. I might as well send you straight to the city." I bet this is the place it told me about.
This is it. We just need to get through the waterfall...
Wait. I thought it was a waterfall. Why does it look like a drawing?
I remember the pretty butterfly leading me to the place. I ran around and had some fun, and then I suddenly found myself back in the city.
Yes! This is definitely it! I remember this place!
The tiny ink critter rushed in here! And the pretty butterfly then flew out of the house!
I now remember what the pretty butterfly said! It asked me tons of questions about you, Endmin!
And how did you answer?
Well, I told it how our mighty Endmin defeated the baddies of Valley IV! I also showed it the two pretty storybooks that we made together!
It applauded me for my lovely drawings. Heheh... I wanted to play some more, but somehow I ended up next to Miss Watchguard.
I was patrolling city premises with the watchguard team when Carly suddenly appeared by my side. Took us all by surprise...
Endmin! Over here!

options: Wait. I suddenly got something to do.

lines.text: An all-new storybook! Everyone will really like it!
Carly! I can't believe you're really here! The entire crew went into total panic mode when you disappeared several days ago!
Thank Talos the Endfielders told us that you're at Wuling. We were about to get a crew to bust a mangler lair to save you!
Uncle Patter! Heheh. Actually, even I got no idea how I ended up at Wuling...
It's okay, Carly. I'm not blaming you... Nobody could have gone so far on their own.
Thank you, Endmin. And this must be the nice watchguard who took care of Carly. You have our most sincere thanks...
Anyone would have done the same.
Carly spent days drawing a new storybook. It's quite fun to look at.
Here, special produce of the Valley and token of our thanks... We're just simple convoy truckers and don't have much to share. I hope you like them.
You're most welcome. Taking care of the people is the duty of the watchguards.
Well, Carly. I guess this is it for our adventure this time.
Yeah. Princess Carly is returning to her castle. And Her Serene Grace shall prepare for the next quest.
Evil Caster and her Weirdo Friend did not show up this time. They will definitely return and destroy our beautiful stuff!
Evil Caster...
Oh yeah, Endmin! This is for you!
What's this?
Miss Watchguard taught me to make this, so I made a super nice one for you, Endmin.
Have a bite!

scenes.summary: You meet Carly at Fangxing Avenue. The little girl is telling a story to the watchguard. Even Carly does not know how she suddenly arrived at Wuling.

lines.text: And at the super finale of the finale, Watergirl returned and joined the Knights of the Sky and Princess Carly once more...! THE END!
Amazing, Carly. Did you do this all by yourself?
Yeah. The Endmin also gave me tons of help!
I just helped, Carly. You're the one who made the storybook.
Oh! Endmin! HAHA! You're here!
And hello there, Endmin!
I didn't expect to see you again!
That's right! Heheh.
Yeah, a branch snagged my old skirt and tore it. So Miss Watchguard bought a new one for me as a present! IT'S! SO! PRETTY!!!
What do you think, Endmin?
It fits perfectly with Princess Carly's aura! Very nice!
YIPPPEE! Miss Watchguard, even the Endmin thinks its very nice!
That's wonderful, Carly.
I don't know what actually happened... I just remember helping the grown-ups pitch the tents and cook some food.
In a tea shrub near the tents, I saw a tiny inky critter that I've never seen before.
I tried to catch it to show the grown-ups and you, Endmin. It ran away, I chased, but somehow ended up at a super pretty place.
And then I, uh... Hmm. I forgot most of it. But I saw a talking butterfly and it brought me out of the pretty place.
Is that so...?
I'll contact the Valley IV crew to verify the situation.
Sounds great!
Endmin, is there anything I could do to help?
Okay.
Ah, Endmin, this is Miss Watchguard! She's hanging out with me!

options: Oh. You got a new dress, Carly.
How did you come to Wuling on your own?

scenes.summary: After calling the crew, you learn that Carly might have been teleported from a distant place to Wuling. It will take a while for the workers to pick her up in the city. Instead of waiting, Carly wants to use this opportunity to write an all-new adventure storybook with you.

lines.text: I asked Fiona to call the workers. A team has been dispatched to pick up Carly.
But they're in another region of Hongshan that's pretty far from Wuling. It will take a while for them to arrive.
A few days? Sure. Carly can definitely stay at my place for the time being. I'm really good with children.
HOORAY! I'm gonna learn how to cook Wuling food with Miss Watchguard! Endmin, since I have to stay here for a while, can I...
Can Carly start working on a brand new storybook? Is that what you want?
Yeah!! You're so incredible, Endmin! You saw right through me!
HOORAY! An all-new mega adventure!

options: Ready for a new adventure, Princess Carly?
Knights of the Sky! Ready for action!

lines.text: Thank you for drawing the storybook with me!
I remember it! I followed that tiny inky critter to a place. A realm! It was HUUUGE!
Shortly after entering the realm, a very pretty butterfly started talking to me.
The pretty butterfly asked me a few questions and sent me back here.
Do you still remember the questions, Carly?
Lemme think... I ... hmm ... I don't think so...
It's alright, Carly. Just tell me when you remember something.
Okay!
